cards.ex: After adding the tomatoes, let the sauce simmer down for about an hour.
cards.exUz: Pomidor qo'shgandan keyin, sousni bir soatga past olovda qaynatib qo'ying.
cards.uzDef: Olovni pasaytirib, suyuqlikni sekin qaynatish, qaynash darajasiga yetkazmaslik.

cards.ex: His presentation on sustainable agriculture was definitely food for thought.
cards.exUz: Uning barqaror qishloq xo'jaligi haqidagi taqdimoti, albatta, o'ylantiradigan narsa edi.
cards.uzDef: O'ylashga, muhokama qilishga arziydigan narsa, g'oya yoki fikr.

cards.ex: That proposal sounds like a half-baked idea to me; it needs more work.
cards.exUz: Bu taklif menga chala pishgan g'oyaga o'xshaydi; unga ko'proq ishlov berish kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshi o'ylanmagan, to'liq rivojlanmagan g'oya yoki reja.

cards.ex: He tried to butter his boss up before asking for a raise.
cards.exUz: U ish haqini oshirishni so'rashdan oldin, boshlig'ini yog'lab yalashga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir maqtash yoki iltifot ko'rsatish orqali o'z maqsadiga erishishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: He's really in the soup after losing all that money at the casino.
cards.exUz: U kazinoda shu qadar ko'p pulni yo'qotgandan so'ng, u haqiqatan ham muammoga tushib qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin ahvolga tushib qolish, muammoga duch kelish.

cards.ex: I need to organize my spice rack; it's a complete mess.
cards.exUz: Men ziravorlar javonimni tartibga solishim kerak; u butunlay tartibsizlik.
cards.uzDef: Ziravorlar saqlanadigan javon yoki idish.

cards.ex: Our school is having a bake-off to raise money for the library.
cards.exUz: Bizning maktab kutubxonaga pul yig'ish uchun pazandalik musobaqasini o'tkazyapti.
cards.uzDef: Pishiriqlar tayyorlash bo'yicha musobaqa.

cards.ex: The recipe is pretty cut and dry, so it should be easy to follow.
cards.exUz: Retsept juda aniq va ravshan, shuning uchun unga amal qilish oson bo'lishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Aniqlangan, hal qilingan, o'zgartirishga hojat yo'q.

cards.ex: I'll plate up the pasta while you pour the drinks.
cards.exUz: Men makaronni tarelkaga solaman, siz esa ichimliklarni quyib bering.
cards.uzDef: Taomni tarelkaga solib, dasturxonga tortish.

cards.ex: The food critic gave our restaurant a glowing review.
cards.exUz: Ovqat tanqidchisi bizning restoranimizga ajoyib baho berdi.
cards.uzDef: Restoranlar va taomlar haqida professional sharhlar yozadigan odam.

cards.ex: Mixing alcohol and driving is a recipe for disaster.
cards.exUz: Spirtli ichimlik ichish va haydash - bu falokat retsepti.
cards.uzDef: Muqarrar ravishda yomon oqibatlarga olib keladigan narsa.

cards.ex: I'm having a craving for chocolate cake right now.
cards.exUz: Hozir menga shokoladli tort yegim kelyapti.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir yeging kelishi, kuchli istak paydo bo'lishi.

cards.ex: I think I got food poisoning from that dodgy restaurant.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, men o'sha shubhali restorandan ovqatdan zaharlanganman.
cards.uzDef: Buzilgan yoki ifloslangan ovqatni iste'mol qilish natijasida kasallanish.

cards.ex: A dash of cooking sherry can really enhance the flavor of this soup.
cards.exUz: Bir oz pazandachilik sherry bu sho'rvaning ta'mini yaxshilashi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Taomga ta'm berish uchun ishlatiladigan sherry vino turi.

cards.ex: He said he didn't want the job anyway, but it sounded like sour grapes to me.
cards.exUz: U baribir ishni xohlamasligini aytdi, lekin bu menga nordon uzumga o'xshab tuyuldi.
cards.uzDef: Eriisholm bo'lmagan narsani yomonlash, hasad qilish.

cards.ex: Teaching English is my bread and butter.
cards.exUz: Ingliz tilidan dars berish - bu mening asosiy daromadim.
cards.uzDef: Asosiy daromad manbai, tirikchilik vositasi.

cards.ex: That takes the biscuit! I can't believe he actually did that.
cards.exUz: Bu juda zo'r! U buni haqiqatan ham qilganiga ishonmayman.
cards.uzDef: Haddan tashqari, uning eng yomoni.

cards.ex: We spent the evening just chewing the fat about old times.
cards.exUz: Biz kechani faqat eski zamonlar haqida gap sotish bilan o'tkazdik.
cards.uzDef: Do'stlar bilan bema'ni gaplashish, suhbatlashish.

cards.ex: He's a hard nut to crack, but I think I'm finally getting through to him.
cards.exUz: U tushunish qiyin odam, lekin menimcha, nihoyat uni tushuntira oldim.
cards.uzDef: Tushunish yoki ishontirish qiyin bo'lgan odam.

cards.ex: They're definitely cooking up something behind closed doors.
cards.exUz: Ular albatta yopiq eshiklar ortida biror narsa rejalashtirishyapti.
cards.uzDef: Yashirincha biror narsa rejalashtirish, ko'pincha yomon narsa.

cards.ex: The desert was bone dry after months without rain.
cards.exUz: Cho'l bir necha oydan beri yomg'ir yog'maganidan keyin quruq qaqragan edi.
cards.uzDef: Mutlaqo quruq, hech qanday namlik yo'q.

cards.ex: The kids were full of beans after their nap.
cards.exUz: Bolalar tushlikdan keyin g'ayratga to'la edi.
cards.uzDef: Energiya va g'ayratga to'la, xursand.

cards.ex: My granddaughter is the apple of my eye.
cards.exUz: Mening nevaram - ko'zimning qorachig'i.
cards.uzDef: Eng sevimli, juda qadrdon odam yoki narsa.

cards.ex: Only the cream of the crop gets accepted into this university.
cards.exUz: Faqat eng yaxshilar ushbu universitetga qabul qilinadi.
cards.uzDef: Eng yaxshi, eng sara, eng yuqori sifatli.

cards.ex: He's on the gravy train since he got that government contract.
cards.exUz: U o'sha hukumat shartnomasini olganidan beri oson daromadga ega.
cards.uzDef: Kam harakat bilan ko'p pul topish imkoniyati.

cards.ex: The crowd went bananas when the band came on stage.
cards.exUz: Guruh sahnaga chiqqanida olomon aqldan ozdi.
cards.uzDef: G'azablanmoq, hayajonlanmoq, aqldan ozganday harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: I can't help you with that now; I have bigger fish to fry.
cards.exUz: Men hozir sizga yordam bera olmayman; muhimroq ishlarim bor.
cards.uzDef: Muhimroq vazifalarni bajarish kerak bo'lganligi sababli, nimadir bilan shug'ullanishni istamaslik.

cards.ex: He had to eat humble pie after his prediction turned out to be wrong.
cards.exUz: Bashorati noto'g'ri bo'lib chiqqanidan keyin u xato qilganini tan olishga majbur bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Xato qilganini tan olish va kechirim so'rash.

cards.ex: Their relationship turned sour after the argument.
cards.exUz: Ular janjallashgandan keyin ularning munosabatlari buzildi.
cards.uzDef: Yomonlashmoq, yaxshi holatdan yomonga o'zgarmoq.

cards.ex: Opera is just not my cup of tea.
cards.exUz: Opera menga umuman yoqmaydi.
cards.uzDef: O'ziga mos emas, yoqtirmaydigan narsa.
